instagramWelcome:
Hi! 👋 Thanks for contacting Korea Trip Hub.
Free Korea travel guides in 12 languages: https://ktriphub.com/?utm_source=instagram&utm_medium=dm&utm_campaign=auto_reply
Visa & K-ETA: https://ktriphub.com/en/plan/visa/
Trip planning: https://ktriphub.com/en/itinerary/
Please tell us your question and preferred language. For entry questions, include your passport country (not your passport number). This is an automated welcome, not a visa decision.
rules: Respond only to inbound travel questions or explicit requests for a guide.

For an explicit guide/link request in an Instagram comment, send one official private reply with the guide link, then acknowledge publicly only after a message receipt. Other questions invite the visitor to DM; do not send unsolicited private messages.
Do not infer passport nationality from language, profile, or location.
Visa answers link to a guide without promising eligibility or approval.
Do not answer complaints, payment disputes, emergencies, or sensitive personal details automatically.
Opt-out, unknown topics, promotional spam, and own-account events receive no automatic topic reply.
API delivery requires persistent event deduplication, cooldown, verified account ownership, and a kill switch.
Uncertain API outcomes require reconciliation, never an automatic resend.
